title: Torque strength and torque steer
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on strong torque and fuel efficiency on one hand, and complaints about torque steer and front-driven power delivery on the other, with several fragments too brief or ambiguous to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise strong torque and, in one case, fuel efficiency, though one assigned-positive example appears ambiguous about bhp and torque.

negative.summary: Negative reviews criticize torque steer as a clear downside to the driving experience.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews pair broader drivetrain criticism with explicit concern that the car feels front-driven and shows torque steer.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention strong torque or suggest changes to power delivery and rear-wheel bias, but the brief wording does not make the overall sentiment clear.

limitations: Several fragments are extremely short, which limits confidence in interpreting sentiment beyond the exact wording.
One assigned-positive example contains wording that sounds critical about bhp and torque, so the positive evidence is somewhat inconsistent.
The topic combines praise for torque strength with criticism of torque steer and drivetrain balance, so it is not a single uniformly framed issue.
